verdict.rationale: Codex ships an official, first-party Codex CLI. It installs via npm or a standalone installer and has extensive docs covering interactive TUI use, non-interactive `codex exec` for scripts and CI, `codex resume`, `codex cloud`, `codex mcp`, subagents, review, permissions and sandbox inspection, and shell completions. The official GitHub repo and hands-on community reports of using models in Codex CLI corroborate this.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Codex CLI is a coding agent from OpenAI that runs locally on your computer.
Use Codex interactively or call codex exec from repeatable workflows and pipelines.
Inspect code, make changes, run commands, and automate repeatable work without leaving your terminal.
Browse active and completed chats, submit work to a configured environment, and apply the result to your local repository from the terminal.
Install the Codex CLI with the standalone installer for macOS and Linux.
